construction.command: docker run --rm --pull=never --platform linux/amd64 --network none --cpus=0.25 --memory=512m --pids-limit=32 --read-only --env ROLE_SKILL_DATA_DIR=/inputs --env OUT_DIR=/out --mount type=bind,source=<experiment-source>,target=/src,readonly --mount type=bind,source=<seed-3788-builder-dir>,target=/inputs,readonly --mount type=bind,source=<construction-output>,target=/out --entrypoint python sha256:4c2cf9917bd1cbacc5e9b07320025bdb7cdf2df7b0ceaccb55e9dd7e30987419 -B /src/construction_runner.py
construction.gate: all four frozen unit tests pass, including exact pure-Python argmax parity for all 12,288 retained rows; otherwise stop before formal

formal.schedule: role index i%3; per-role fixture index (i*37+11)%4096
formal.decision: PASS only if 30,000 predictions match the paired arms and frozen expected outputs, hashes unchanged, independent audit has zero errors and both declared mutations are rejected, reuse wins at least 12/15 blocks, median lifetime-cost ratio <=0.90, and median first break-even N <=1000 with non-crossing blocks censored as 1001; otherwise retain exact FAIL/HOLD/STOP

stop_rules: any source, input, image, output-path, or allocation identity mismatch
any failed process, malformed or incomplete raw result, independent-audit error, or mutation-control failure
no reruns, replacement, tuning, or pooling
scope_limit: one retained synthetic package/seed; pure-Python scorer only; no PyTorch/framework performance, generalization, GUI, authority, or product claim
